name: University of Windsor - Undergraduate
description: The University of Windsor (U of W or UWindsor) is a public comprehensive and research university in Windsor, Ontario, Canada. The University of Windsor has nine faculties, including the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences, the Faculty of Education, the Faculty of Engineering, Odette School of Business, the Faculty of Graduate Studies, the Faculty of Human Kinetics, the Faculty of Law, the Faculty of Nursing, and the Faculty of Science. University of Windsor is ranked #1049 in Best Global Universities. Timestamps Updated
